snippet.title: EPITAPH: The Parchment Anthology TRAILER ENG
snippet.description:
A text-based horror game where every choice matters.

You wake up buried underground, trapped inside a coffin, and must find a way out. But something is moving around you…

Available in English and Italian.
Releases April 27 on Steam.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4613610/EPITAPH_The_Parchment_Anthology/
